records.part: Emergency zone mapping software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution for protective action coordination and public information
records.reason: In June 2024 the Board of Supervisors approved a contract with Genasys, Inc. for an emergency zone mapping software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution called Genasys EVAC for use by all public safety agencies within the County.

records.part: ReadySBC Alerts system software for public alert dissemination (email, text, voice, TTY/TDD, IPAWS WEA/EAS)
records.reason: The Everbridge software powering the ReadySBC Alerts system is currently funded by the County’s General Fund.
